curation.notes: Mechanical unzipping of a 3593 bp DNA hairpin (GAAA tetraloop, 29 bp handles) in a temperature-jump MiniTweezers optical trap (single trap + micropipette) between 7 and 42 °C, using a 1435 nm heating laser and an ice-box for low temperatures; chamber temperature determined from Stokes-drag viscosity measurements. Force-distance curves fitted to derive temperature-dependent nearest-neighbour free energies, entropies, enthalpies and heat-capacity changes.

evidence.snippet: Experiments have been carried out in the temperature range [7,42] °C in a buffer of 1M NaCl, 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), and 1 mM EDTA.
binds to a 3 μm diameter polystyrene bead coated with anti-DIG (AD). The other end is labeled with biotin (BIO), which binds to a 2 μm diameter streptavidin-coated bead (SA).
Experiments have been performed at a constant pulling speed, v = 100 nm/s.
